# Scanned materials
These 1K photographic color, OpenGL normal and roughness maps are from Poly Haven and released under CC0.

- Aerial Grass Rock — Rob Tuytel: https://polyhaven.com/a/aerial_grass_rock
- Aerial Asphalt 01 — Rob Tuytel: https://polyhaven.com/a/aerial_asphalt_01
- Brick Wall 003 — Dimitrios Savva and Rob Tuytel: https://polyhaven.com/a/brick_wall_003

License: https://polyhaven.com/license

Architecture, road geometry, facades, vegetation layout, terrain and water shader are generated by the application. Cities: Skylines II screenshots are used only as visual references and are not included in this repository.

Detailed window/door meshes and their PBR textures are adapted from [Modular Urban Apartments Facade](https://polyhaven.com/a/modular_urban_apartments_facade), James Ray Cock / Poly Haven, CC0. The shipped glTF contains three selected modules and a compacted buffer. The original kit is not shipped in full.

## Edition 7 rendering assets

- Additional wall, window, door and crown geometry and PBR materials from
  [Modular Urban Apartments Facade](https://polyhaven.com/a/modular_urban_apartments_facade),
  James Ray Cock / Poly Haven. CC0. Five selected modules; unused geometry,
  materials and textures removed from the glTF.
- [Pine Sapling Small](https://polyhaven.com/a/pine_sapling_small), Rico Cilliers
  (modeling) and Rob Tuytel (photography) / Poly Haven. CC0. One selected tree
  variant, normalized at runtime; geometry used nearby, rendered impostors farther away.
- [Tree Small 02](https://polyhaven.com/a/tree_small_02), Rico Cilliers / Poly Haven.
  CC0. Four transparent 640×768 views rendered from the source 3D model for
  efficient broadleaf vegetation. The high-polygon source is not distributed.
- [Syferfontein 1d Clear](https://polyhaven.com/a/syferfontein_1d_clear),
  Poly Haven. CC0. 1K HDR environment for daylight, sky and reflections.

All Poly Haven assets above: https://polyhaven.com/license
RGBELoader is Three.js r170, MIT, alongside the existing Three.js license.

## Edition 10 close-range vegetation

Tree Small 02 by Rico Cilliers / Poly Haven (CC0) is also supplied as a simplified 3D GLB for nearby trees. Reduced with glTF Transform/meshoptimizer to a target 2% geometry ratio, with textures resized to 512 pixels. Distant trees retain the rendered views.

## Edition 12 terrain

[Rock Face 03](https://polyhaven.com/a/rock_face_03), Poly Haven, CC0. The 1K diffuse and OpenGL normal maps are used for exposed terrain. License: https://polyhaven.com/license

## Edition 13 complete building libraries and scanned coast

- [Modular Urban Apartments Facade](https://polyhaven.com/a/modular_urban_apartments_facade), James Ray Cock / Poly Haven, CC0. Artist-created facade modules assembled into 16 complete buildings, with original textures, simplified geometry and additional original roof/entrance geometry.
- [Modular Factory Facade](https://polyhaven.com/a/modular_factory_facade), Poly Haven, CC0. Artist-created modules assembled into five complete industrial, retail and loft buildings; simplified geometry with original textures.
- [Coast Rocks 02](https://polyhaven.com/a/coast_rocks_02), Poly Haven, CC0. Scanned coastal geometry simplified and textures resized to 1K.

These GLB files embed their textures. Building assemblies are original adaptations, not Cities: Skylines II assets. All source assets use https://polyhaven.com/license . Earlier procedural models remain as loading-failure fallbacks.

Edition 14 adds simplified distant geometry derived from the same CC0 building assemblies and further simplifies Coast Rocks 02 to 3,527 triangles. Original embedded textures are reused by both building detail levels.

## Edition 21 modern architecture

Fifteen original Borough modern buildings: glass office towers, stepped and terraced apartments, courtyard blocks, balcony towers, retail buildings, and contemporary houses. Generated by `scripts/build-modern-library.py` with actual inset glazing, window blinds, façade frames, balcony slabs, roof plant and roof gardens. The roof surfaces reuse the existing CC0 asphalt photograph credited above. These are original models, not Cities: Skylines II assets. Lightweight geometry stays intact at every viewing distance; the older detailed masonry assemblies retain their existing distant models.

## Edition 27 facade and roof details

Modern-library parapets, divided balconies, terrace furniture/pergolas and rooftop fan geometry are original Borough assets. The existing CC0 brick scans listed above are embedded at 512 pixels for metre-scale cladding. No Cities: Skylines game assets are included.

Edition 96 adds original stepped-gable and bell-gable brick terraces. Their geometry, sash windows, stone trim, entrances and roof details are generated by `scripts/build-modern-library.py` and reuse the credited CC0 brick and roof textures. The Netherlands Region Pack developer diary was a visual reference; its pictures and game models are not included.

Edition 114 adds original raised-stoop and dormer-roof brick terraces, using the same credited brick and roof textures. The row-house pictures in the official Cities: Skylines II Zones & Signature Buildings feature were visual references. Their images and game geometry are not included.
